title: Makeup Advance When a Drafted Account Cannot Be Drafted Again — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Clause.** On the **Installment Payment Plans**, the makeup of a payment returned on a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term carries an advance when the drafted account cannot be drafted again:

1. **The plan still bills by automatic draft** (its signed recurring authorizations outnumber its revocations), **the returned payment is coded account closed or stop payment by payer**, and an installment remains after the one its invoice billed but has not been invoiced: the makeup adds that next installment's scheduled premium.
2. **The plan still so bills, the return is so coded, and the next installment has already been invoiced:** the makeup adds that invoice's minimum due less the payment posted against it, if any, plus every amount the bank returned against that payment.
3. **Otherwise** — the plan no longer bills by automatic draft, the return is coded otherwise, the returned payment had paid no installment invoice, or no installment remains — the makeup adds no advance.

**The next installment's scheduled premium.** It is the full-term premium billed less the schedule's down payment premium, divided by the plan's number of installments and rounded half up to the cent; for the final installment, the full-term premium billed less the down payment premium and less that installment premium for every earlier installment. The schedule's down payment premium is the plan's recorded down payment amount less the fully earned fees it took: the policy fee booked on the Owner Auto Policy term and every filing fee the filing ledger shows assessed on the day the plan was set up for the certificate whose backing term is the owner term, whatever that certificate's present status.

**Truth table (hypothetical; plan of five installments, returned payment had paid installment 2's invoice)**

| Draft authorization in force | Return reason | Installment 3 invoiced? | Advance |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | account closed | no | installment 3's scheduled premium |
| yes | stop payment by payer | yes, minimum due 190.00, no payment posted against it | 190.00 |
| yes | insufficient funds | either | none |
| no (revoked) | account closed | no | none |

The authorizations and revocations, the return reason and the invoices are read from the plan; the policy fee from the Owner Auto Policy term.
